en: Sepia-toned portrait postcard showing a formal studio-style side profile of a man with wavy hair, moustache, and bow tie, wearing a suit. The image has a soft vignette effect. At the upper left, the name 'Charles de Beriot' is printed in small type, and at the lower right is the number '131'. The reverse side is not visible but the format and margins resemble an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.
